title: Townsquare Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Townsquare Media, Inc. (NYSE: TSQ) announced today its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
**Q3 Digital Advertising Revenue YoY Growth Accelerates to 13% Digital Represents 57% of September YTD Net Revenue and 56% of Segment Profit**


**Purchase, NY – November 4, 2026** – Townsquare Media, Inc. (NYSE: TSQ) (“Townsquare”, the “Company,” “we,” “us” or “our”) announced today its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“Townsquare’s third quarter results reflect the continued strength of our Digital Advertising platform,” commented Bill Wilson, Chief Executive Officer of Townsquare Media, Inc. “Third quarter net revenue of $110.9 million increased 3.9% year-over-year and exceeded our guidance range, Adjusted EBITDA of $22.6 million increased 2.7% year-over-year and was within our guidance range, and net loss narrowed by $1.5 million year-over-year to $4.0 million. These results were driven by the growth of Townsquare Ignite, our Digital Advertising business, and by political revenue that is tracking ahead of our expectations. Digital Advertising net revenue grew 12.7% year-over-year, accelerating for the third consecutive quarter, led by programmatic revenue growth of 22.5%. Our Media Partnerships business now serves 18 partners and extends our digital programmatic advertising platform to 122 markets across the United States, and we expect Media Partnerships revenue to more than double in 2026. In addition, Townsquare Interactive delivered strong profitability, with Segment Profit margins of 36% in Q3, as we rebuild and grow our sales team.”


Mr. Wilson continued, “At the same time, we want to be candid about the challenges we face. Our local clients continue to feel pressure from higher operating costs and interest rates, and they are scrutinizing every marketing dollar, particularly those spent on traditional media. Excluding political, Broadcast Advertising net revenue declined 5.2% in the third quarter. We expect those declines to deepen in the fourth quarter, partly as political advertising crowds out other inventory. In addition, while Townsquare Interactive’s profit remains strong, lower-than-anticipated sales velocity means it will not return to sequential revenue growth in Q4 2026 as we had projected.”


“Given these challenges, and the meaningful direct impact of higher interest rates on our floating-rate debt, we have made the decision, together with our Board, to suspend our quarterly dividend,” concluded Mr. Wilson, “We do not believe that the market is ascribing value to the dividend and we believe this cash can generate greater value for shareholders elsewhere. Suspending the dividend will preserve approximately $14 million of cash annually, which we will use for general corporate liquidity and to opportunistically pursue higher-return opportunities. We believe this is the prudent course for Townsquare and our stakeholders, and that it positions us to continue investing in our digital growth engine while strengthening our financial flexibility.”


In November 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors approved the suspension of its quarterly cash dividend in order to redirect capital toward general corporate liquidity and strategic growth opportunities. The previously declared quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share was paid on November 2, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October 26, 2026. Any future declaration of dividends will be at the discretion of the Board of Directors.

##### About Townsquare Media, Inc.


**Townsquare** is a community-focused digital and broadcast media and digital marketing solutions company principally focused outside the top 50 markets in the U.S. **Townsquare Ignite** , our robust digital advertising division, specializes in helping businesses of all sizes connect with their target audience through data-driven, results based strategies, by utilizing a) our proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology stack with an in-house demand and data management platform and b) our owned and operated portfolio of more than 400 local news and entertainment websites and mobile apps along with a network of leading national music and entertainment brands, collecting valuable first party data. **Townsquare Interactive** , our subscription digital marketing services business, partners with SMBs to help manage their digital presence by providing a SAAS business management platform, website design, creation and hosting, search engine optimization and other digital services. And through our portfolio of local radio stations strategically situated outside the Top 50 markets in the United States, we provide effective advertising solutions for our clients and relevant local content for our audiences. For more information, please visit[www.townsquaremedia.com](https://www.townsquaremedia.com/) ,[www.townsquareinteractive.com](https://www.townsquareinteractive.com/) , and[www.townsquareignite.com](https://townsquareignite.com/) .
